failure_policy: Any failed hard gate removes the candidate; zero eligible candidates yields INCONCLUSIVE and stops before M-B10B.

rules.name: Lineage intact from source through runtime
rules.pass_condition: All required phase identities and immutable A5/A6 paths exist and hash-match.

rules.name: Strict INT8 and no Flex/Select ops
rules.pass_condition: Actual finalist binary has int8 input/output, expected shapes, and zero Select TF ops.

rules.name: Clean VALIDATION has no required-class prediction collapse
rules.pass_condition: Recomputed clean VALIDATION prediction distribution and class recalls are nonzero.

rules.name: No new M-B6 conversion-induced required-class collapse
rules.pass_condition: M-B6 class-collapse transition audit reports no Stage-A to Stage-C new collapse.

rules.name: M-B9 runtime and prediction identity match M-B6 artifact
rules.pass_condition: Runtime path, SHA, bytes, model version, and direct/runtime INT8 output, probability, and Top-1 identities match the M-B6 Stage-C artifact.

rules.name: Valid finalist with no heuristic fallback
rules.pass_condition: M-B9 valid finalist scenario records are valid, use MODEL_PREDICTION, and have no fallback or fallback reason; fault scenarios remain diagnostic.

rules.name: Runtime preprocessing equals BPF_ZSCORE
rules.pass_condition: M-B1 selected profile and M-B9 preprocessing identity agree exactly.

rules.name: No artifact/runtime/checksum/provenance blocker
rules.pass_condition: Upstream blocker registries are empty and all frozen identity checks pass.

rules.name: No required class has clean VALIDATION recall exactly zero
rules.pass_condition: Recomputed NORMAL, RAPID_OR_ABNORMAL, and APNEA recalls are all > 0.

rules.name: No required class has clean VALIDATION precision exactly zero
rules.pass_condition: Recomputed NORMAL, RAPID_OR_ABNORMAL, and APNEA precisions are all > 0.

rules.name: No class collapse under moderate M-B7 profiles
rules.pass_condition: Every moderate profile remains non-collapsed for the candidate seed.
